# Dashboard Instructions

## Approved Behavior

- Dashboard background color is `#d7e0e3`.
- Default view is a table.
- Employees are sorted alphabetically by name.
- The table shows 20 employees per page.
- Filter changes refresh results immediately in place.
- Employee rows are clickable.
- Clicking an employee opens an 80% viewport employee 360 modal.
- The modal is scrollable.
- The modal closes from a top-right close button or by clicking outside it.

## Display Expectations

- Show employee name and company role.
- Show visible fields that correspond to filterable data where practical, including location, experience, certifications, and skills summary.
- Keep table rows scan-friendly.
- Do not add catalog tabs or search from the reference screenshot unless the approved plan changes.
